audio_note: 짧은 사용자 업로드 음성 클립. 원작 권리는 각 권리자에게 있습니다. 공식 제공 게임 음원이 아닙니다.

models.author: Nini (@doniisw)
models.geometry: Imported original GLB meshes with runtime Loop subdivision and proportion refinements based on user-supplied figure photographs.
models.smile_behavior: Chiikawa and Hachiware use photo-derived calm, smiling and frightened expressions. Usagi always keeps the photo-derived base face, including scared, held, juggling and eating states.
models.expression_reference: User-supplied Chiikawa, Hachiware and Usagi figure photographs, 2026-10-23
models.expression_modifications: Chiikawa sadness uses worried eyebrows and a downturned mouth. Hachiware crying eyes, eyebrows and small mouth are extracted directly from the additional user-supplied crying illustration and used when a friend is eaten, while crying and throughout juggling. Both share the same flowing 3D tear effect. Usagi keeps its fixed photo-derived face.

weapon_modifications: Six white spikes anchored to the inner fork surface on each sasumata. Usagi carries a yellow staff with white tips. Visible palms are constrained to shaft grip points through all animation states.
